question.text: For a long put on USDINR at strike 83, when does the option have a positive payoff (before premium) at expiry?

answer.text: USDINR stays exactly at 83 at expiry
USDINR remains unchanged from the purchase date

explanation.text: The Logic: The payoff table on page 84 of the source shows a long put on USDINR has a positive gross payoff at any spot below the strike: payoff = max(83 - spot, 0). Net P/L only turns positive once spot falls below strike minus premium (the BEP). The Trap: At a spot equal to or above the strike the put expires worthless; positive payoff and positive net profit are different conditions — the former triggers at spot < 83, the latter at spot < 82.925 in the source's example. Note: A long put on USDINR is a bet on INR appreciation (USDINR falling).
